// exclude tests: Test/e2e files are never part of the shipped .d.ts API, and some import across the repo (e.g. app/lib helpers). Compiling them here would drag those out-of-rootDir files into the emit, shifting the declaration output path so dependent plugins (mobile-bridge) can't resolve `tabby-plugin-ai-sidebar` — which broke a release build. tsc typechecks tests via tsconfig.json + vitest runs them; they must NOT be in the typings build.
